question: The equivalent capacitance of the combination shown in the figure is :
diagram_alt: Two capacitors C in parallel between the terminals, with a third capacitor C connected between the two branches on their right-hand side
solution:
Both plates of the middle capacitor are connected, by plain wires, to the right-hand junction. It is short-circuited and stores no charge.

The remaining two capacitors $C$ are in parallel between the two terminals:
$$C_{eq} = C + C = 2C$$
